end.line: Quillon for Ashcombe Reed’s banking team

vo: Ashcombe Reed’s banking team runs a hundred and eighty facility agreements a year; clients want each back in twenty-four hours.
In Word, Quillon marks up the cure period to fifteen business days and cites the firm’s lender-side position.
Your market positions live in one playbook, learned from thirty-eight closed matters and reviewed by a partner.
Ask which agreements trigger on a sponsor sale, and every answer is cited to the clause and the page.
Priya will walk your team through it on Monday the ninth.
